high_risk_cohorts.name: Low-VIX Lunchtime Theta Decay Trap
high_risk_cohorts.root_cause: G-period lunchtime lull induces rapid theta decay in low-volatility grinding regimes.
high_risk_cohorts.safeguard_rule: Exit all long options before 12:15 PM or wait strictly for Period H (12:45 PM) candle close outside IB.

high_risk_cohorts.name: Stock Breakout vs Index Drag (Divergence Trap)
high_risk_cohorts.root_cause: Individual stock breakout lacks institutional support when broader indices are selling off.
high_risk_cohorts.safeguard_rule: Never buy Call Options (CE) on stock breakouts if Nifty or Bank Nifty is trading below Open or printing bearish PCR velocity.

high_risk_cohorts.name: False Wick Breakout (No Candle Close)
high_risk_cohorts.root_cause: Institutional stop hunts (liquidity sweeps) trigger breakouts that immediately collapse back into value.
high_risk_cohorts.safeguard_rule: Mandatory Candle Close Filter: 5-minute bar must close strictly outside the IB trigger level before entry.

high_risk_cohorts.name: Wide-IB Exhaustion False Breakdown
high_risk_cohorts.root_cause: Morning volatility fuel is exhausted early; afternoon breaks become 2-way Neutral Day rotation traps.
high_risk_cohorts.safeguard_rule: In wide-IB sessions (>0.8%), cap daily range multiplier to 1.36x and look to fade extremes at Value Area boundaries.

high_risk_cohorts.name: Late-Day Low-Volume Trap (Period L)
high_risk_cohorts.root_cause: Period L breakouts without 1.2x volume spikes are closing auction traps that reverse before 3:30 PM.
high_risk_cohorts.safeguard_rule: Require 1.2x to 1.3x volume expansion for any breakout initiated after 02:45 PM.

summary: Mined 5 distinct error cohorts. Top failure drivers: is_vix_low, is_divergent, is_wick_spike.
